title: Predicator conformance authored case
description: An authored case in conformance/cases/*.json, before mix corpus.generate completes it. See conformance/README.md for the full field-by-field contract.

id.description: Human-chosen, path-like, globally unique, stable forever. Never renamed once shipped.

source.description: A predicator expression. Exactly one of source or instructions is present (non-null).

instructions.description: A raw instruction list, for evaluator-only cases no source compiles to (e.g. the legacy ["and"]/["or"] opcodes). Exactly one of source or instructions is present (non-null).

context.description: Variable bindings, tagged-value encoded. Defaults to {}.

expected.description: An assertion, checked against the real compiler/evaluator's computed result at generation time. Generation fails loudly on disagreement.

result.description: The expected evaluation result, tagged-value encoded.

type.description: The error struct's short module name, e.g. "TypeMismatchError".

reason.description: A structured reason token. Normative. The error message is never carried.

tier.description: An assertion. Computed as max(tier(opcode)) over the case's instructions; disagreement fails generation naming the case and the forcing opcode.

features.description: Extra feature tags merged with the computed set. Not a replacement for the computed tags.

notes.description: Free text carried into the shipped corpus. JSON has no comments; this is the substitute.
